describe: The image shows a weathered concrete surface, grey-olive stone with a rough, pitted texture. Small raised bumps, shallow pits and faint horizontal trowel marks cover the surface, with dark grime patches in the lower areas. Colours are muted grey, khaki and dark olive with lighter pale highlights. Lighting is soft with moderate contrast, and the pattern is an irregular, non-repeating rough finish with no bricks or joints.
